statement: Exploratory and post hoc: the result is a candidate at most and changes no registered reading, flag or decision.
not_done: No test outside tests_enumerated.json was run, and none of its tests was altered. The family is the one fixed there (137 tests).

The tests use one measured value per point: the raw variance of the point's gradients, which every post-run review names 'measured' and against which the reviews' written ratios (0.50, 0.92, 0.71 in the plan) are formed. The reviews also give a 'signal' variance (raw minus the shot variance), and the pipeline's compare_points sets that one against the prediction. The list of tests was closed before this was seen, so no test was run on the signal variance; ln(signal / prediction) is given per point in the table, without any test.
2 of 67 points were left out because the post-run review prints no measured value for them; no value was estimated in their place.
The check of each point's prediction row against the review is a comparison of printed figures; for points where the review states no prediction value (level-2 and k = L points) it could not be made.
The table is the provisional one (own implementation of the per-value rule of draft Deviation 65); the repetition on the table rebuilt with the adopted builder (plan Section 9) is not done.
No independent check of these results has been made (plan Section 6 asks for one before the result is quoted anywhere).
No measured value was re-estimated by another method; no prediction was re-drawn; no IBM service was called.

outcome_in_the_words_of_plan_section_5.words: Primary test significant. Section 5 makes a candidate of 'Primary test significant, same sign on days 1 and 2 separately'. Day 1 holds no flagged point, so the sign on day 1 cannot be formed and the condition is not met as Section 5 is written: not a candidate in its words; Section 5 names no outcome for this case. Beside it, as a reading not fixed in advance: on the only day where the sign can be formed (day 2) the difference is negative; under the reading 'same sign on the days where it can be formed' this would be a candidate, to be tested prospectively on day 3 as Section 5 says, and nothing more. In neither case is any registered reading, flag or decision of days 1, 2 or 10 Nov changed.
